overview_description.description:
Catawiki is the leading online marketplace to buy and sell special objects. 

Over 75,000 objects are offered in auction every week - each reviewed and selected by one of Catawiki’s hundreds of in-house experts specialised in Art, Design, Jewellery, Fashion, Classic Cars, Collectables and much more. 

Catawiki is headquartered in Amsterdam with over 750 employees across the world.
